# Cron notes

cron is a scheduler. When cron fires, cron runs the command in a bare environment. cron does not
inherit your shell. cron timezones come from the daemon, not the entry. Debugging cron means
checking cron logs, cron permissions, and cron's own environment. Every cron question is really a
cron environment question. cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron cron
